meta.title: Promptcha — prompt workbench
meta.description: A ready-to-use AI prompt from plain words. For Midjourney, ChatGPT, Claude, DALL·E, Sora and Cursor.

app.title: Turn your idea into a precise prompt
app.subtitle: A workbench that turns rough ideas into technical instructions a professional AI understands.
app.placeholder: For example: I need a logo for a national cuisine restaurant. Simple, modern, with a tandoor or bread symbol.
app.hint: Tip: describe the main subject, style and mood in your own words.
app.kindSuggested: This looks like “{kind}”. If that is right, generate again, otherwise pick another.
app.checkBody: Generated parameters are fully aligned with the syntax rules of the selected model ({ai} {version}).
app.guestExhausted: Free attempts are used up. Sign in to continue.
app.textTooShort: Write at least a few words.
app.connectionLost: The connection dropped before the result arrived. Please try again.

clarify.title: Clarification
clarify.subtitle: One or two questions for a quality prompt. Pick one or more options, or write your own.

result.title: Ready prompt
